title: ichnocarpus loureiroi
intro: Ichnocarpus loureiroi, commonly known as Ichnocarpus, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. The health benefits of Ichnocarpus loureiroi include its use as a treatment for various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and coughs. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Ichnocarpus loureiroi include alkaloids and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
